d:
Alag alag gayki evan vibhinn sangit shaili men shri hanuman chalisa ka 7 bar shravan avashy karen evan hanuman ji ka aashirvad prapt karen mangalvar, shanivar evan pratidin hanuman chalisa ka path evan shravan karne se bhay, sankat aur nakaratmakta dur hoti hai tatha jivan men sukh, shanti, sahas aur saphalta ka marg prashast hota hai .
Hanuman chalisa gulshan kumar, hanuman chalisa lata mangeshkar, hanuman chalisa hari Om sharan, hanuman chalisa mahendr kapur, hanuman chalisa nitin mukesh, hanuman chalisa narendr chanchal, hanuman chalisa kailash piyush anuj
